name: Mother of Steel (Paragon Hag Archetype)
body:
Some hags never truly discard the tools of humanoid weapons, focusing on steel or staff while allowing her natural weapons to atrophy.

Steel Focus

A mother of steel chooses any simple or martial weapon for her soul focus. She is always considered proficient with her soul focus and receives a masterwork weapon as her soul focus at 1st level. This ability modifies soul focus.

Hag’s Weapon (Ex)

A mother of steel does not gain claws. Instead, she may use her hag’s claws damage in place of her soul focus’s base damage. She must decide which she intends to use before making the attack roll.

At 2nd level, her soul focus is considered magical for the purposes of bypassing DR.

She gains +1 to attack and damage rolls with her soul focus at 6th level. This bonus increases by +1 at 10th level, 14th level, and 18th level.

This ability replaces hag’s claws.
